manifest.holdoutPolicy: reporting only; never read by selection, mutation or targeting
manifest.costPolicy: recordsScored charges train + calibration records for every exact evaluation plus every calibration record scored while screening targeted candidates; holdout records are reported separately and never charged; the behavioural-diversity probe activations are counted as diagnosticRecords and also never charged; wallMs is indicative only
manifest.diversityPolicy: behavioural diversity: mean pairwise RMS difference of the first output over the first 64 calibration records, averaged over generations 2 and later (generation 1 is the identical seeded population in every arm); the ratio is the median over seeds of arm / control; measurement only, never read by selection, mutation or targeting; genetic distance and species count are reported but not used
